marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Fan zou guo bi liu xia gu shi

This book tells the story of a secondgeneration overseas Chinese from Fujian who went to the South China Sea to survive during the war in the 1930's. The author was born in Malaysia (then called "Malaya"). The author was born in Malaysia (then known as "Malaya"), and experienced his father's departure from his home country, the hard work of starting his own business, having children and raising them, and a lifetime of caring for his hometown. The author's own education, employment, social work, and even concern for the politics of his home country and the social, educational, and cultural issues, and the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and the country of his ancestry.
